cwm.objectNotFound: {{id}} does not exist (it was deleted or moved).
cwm.objectArchived: {{id}} has ended: it was archived to {{path}}.
cwm.objectConflict: {{id}} was changed by someone else since you opened it — reload it, then redo your change.
cwm.objectReferenced: {{id}} cannot be deleted: {{by}} still depend on it.
cwm.transitionFromTerminal: {{id}} is in {{state}}, a final state of {{workflow}}: it moves no further.
cwm.lifecycleRetiredField: {{id}}: the lifecycle has no {{field}} — an item follows the workflow of its kind, and its moves are recorded by the journal.
cwm.forceNotAllowed: The move "{{transition}}" is refused ({{reason}}), and it cannot be forced.
cwm.forceNeedsPerson: The move "{{transition}}" is refused ({{reason}}); forcing it takes a person and a note.
cwm.unknownType: The kind {{type}} of {{id}} is declared by no pack.
cwm.abstractType: {{type}} is a general kind: create one of its more precise kinds instead.
cwm.retiredType: The kind {{type}} is retired: the items already of it are read until the project is converted - create one of the kind that replaces it ({{replaced}}).
cwm.brokenLink: {{id}}: {{link}} — a link must name an item of the project.
cwm.descriptionTooLong: The description is {{chars}} characters long; {{type}} allows {{max}}.
cwm.childTypeNotAllowed: A {{type}} cannot be placed under a {{parentType}}.
cwm.unknownCapability: {{id}} carries the property {{capability}}, which no pack declares.
cwm.unknownAspect: {{id}} names the property {{aspect}}, which no pack declares.
cwm.sizeBudget: {{id}} would be {{bytes}} bytes, over the {{max}} bytes {{type}} allows — shorten it.

actions.fieldNotMutable: The field {{field}} cannot be changed here.
actions.transitionOnly: {{field}} changes only through a transition of its workflow.

agent.modelKeyMissing: The task could not call the language model {{model}}: its key is not installed. Import the keys: Check installation › Keys, then run the task again. ({{reason}})
agent.modelKeyRefused: The language model {{model}} refused the key: it is invalid or has lost its rights. Import valid keys: Check installation › Keys, then run the task again. ({{reason}})
agent.modelUnreachable: The language model {{model}} cannot be reached: check the network and the service address (Check installation › Keys), then run the task again. ({{reason}})
agent.modelUnknown: The service does not know the language model {{model}}: check the model chosen for this task and the keys (Check installation › Keys), then run the task again. ({{reason}})
agent.modelCallFailed: The call to the language model {{model}} failed: the task ends failed. Run it again; if the error comes back, check the installation (Check installation › Keys). ({{reason}})

panel.unknownPanel: The panel {{panel}} is not kept (it has not started or has ended).

load.timedOut: The read did not answer within {{seconds}} s - the universe may be busy or restarting.
